Service brought in $203,106 (`[IS_2026-06.xlsx]Service!C20`) of the company's Q2 gross profit of $1,865,328 (`[IS_2026-06.xlsx]Total!C20`). The tools don't calculate a unit's share of the total, and I haven't worked out that percentage myself. Wholesale and Online contributed much more gross profit in dollars, because Service's net sales were only $440,689 (`Service!C13`).

The figures come from the approved June export (Controller, 2026-07-08), which is usable.
